ORDER.conditional_requirements: For MEDICATION orders require dose_quantity, dose_unit, route, order_start_at, as_needed and max_doses_per_day; scheduled orders also require positive dose_interval_hours. Other order families do not carry fake medication fields.

OBSERVATION.parent: optional earlier order; numeric or qualitative value required, not both empty

LAB_RESULT.parent: earlier compatible ORDER; collection<=result_ready<=knowledge; each analyte is one scalar row

PROCEDURE.parent: earlier compatible ORDER; not-done/cancelled not billed

MED_ADMIN.parent: earlier active medication ORDER; completed administration consumes positive converted stock; schedule/PRN maximum checked by stable order and local day
MED_ADMIN.conditional_requirements: COMPLETED requires positive consumed_base_quantity and resolvable consumption_group_key; CANCELLED/NOT_DONE consumes zero and has null consumption group. Inpatient ward dispensing is a transfer, not a second consumed dose. MED_DISPENSE represents take-home supply only in v1.

MED_DISPENSE.parent: earlier medication ORDER; prescribed quantity is not assumed administered
MED_DISPENSE.conditional_requirements: COMPLETED requires positive consumed_base_quantity and resolvable consumption_group_key; CANCELLED/NOT_DONE consumes zero and has null consumption group. Inpatient ward dispensing is a transfer, not a second consumed dose. MED_DISPENSE represents take-home supply only in v1.

DOCUMENT.parent: optional provenance; catalog_item_id null; only facts known at occurred_at
